notes: Now playing: a glass shelf in the top right shows music or anything playing in the background; press Up from the dock to pause, open or quit it. Sony BRAVIA support: tidy-up, Optimize, AirPlay in Cast, Netflix and Google Play buttons. Copy settings no longer offers to install an app the TV already has under another name (like Apple TV). Inputs like HDMI 3 (eARC/ARC) are listed in order.
